subject.title: [Bug]: The project won't start on Windows and WSL.

question: Should maintainers require current-main Windows/WSL second-build logs before choosing between a tsdown dependency update, wrapper fix, or rollback to `tsc`?
rationale: The report is credible and affects supported setup paths, but the proposed rollback is a broad build-tool decision and the current evidence does not isolate the failing tsdown/rolldown path.

options.title: Require focused Windows/WSL repro first
options.body: Ask for or run a current-main first-build and second-build repro with full logs before selecting dependency update, wrapper fix, or rollback.

options.title: Treat as beta-blocking now
options.body: Escalate immediately as release-blocking build-tool work and let maintainers pick a fix direction before full isolation.

options.title: Choose a rollback direction
options.body: Accept the reporter's `tsc` rollback direction, but only with maintainer-owned migration and release-build proof because it changes the core build system.

recommendation.title: Require focused Windows/WSL repro first
recommendation.body: Ask for or run a current-main first-build and second-build repro with full logs before selecting dependency update, wrapper fix, or rollback.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is mainly build-tool direction, and steipete has recent adjacent build history plus direct reporter escalation in the discussion.
